# no loop: run stage one of the flow, read the envelope it wrote, judge it with the constraint rule
# and then the goal rule, and complete the goal only when both passed.
#
# There is no revisit edge: the one strategy knob holds a single legal value, so no decision can
# open another generation or ask a different question. A different input is a new Campaign, not a
# second generation of this one.
id: library-authoring-qualification
version: '1'
entry: analyze

nodes:
  # Act: run the pack's tool on the Site, in the Campaign's own copy of the flow, and wait for it.
  # Only the strategy knob is chosen here — the name of the input fixture, whose one legal value is
  # the flow's own. WORKSPACE is the Run's own workspace, which the fabric already holds and a node
  # may not bind.
  - id: analyze
    kind: act
    parameters:
      tool: analyze-library-contract
      arguments:
        INPUT_FIXTURE: { from: strategy, name: inputFixture }

  # Act: read the envelope that generation produced into HimaLedger, through the contract's own
  # reader. When the flow refuses the input, or the envelope is not valid, this reading produces no
  # value at all — which is not a zero and never becomes one.
  - id: read-contract
    kind: act
    parameters:
      observes: libraryContract

  # Judge: the constraint rule first, then the goal rule whose bound goal the Run binds. The
  # outgoing edge is chosen by the outcome of the first rule listed — the constraint.
  - id: judge
    kind: judge
    parameters:
      rules:
        - library-contract-nonnegative
        - library-contract-goal
      bind:
        library_contract_goal: { from: goal, name: library_contract_goal }

  # Explore: the only place a Campaign of this pack can be ended as goal met, and only on the
  # constraint's PASS together with the goal's PASS. The chooser declares no next strategy, because
  # there is nothing to vary; any other combination matches no clause and reaches no goal-met
  # decision.
  - id: decide
    kind: explore
    parameters:
      chooser: library-contract-decide

  # Wait: where a Run stops for a person — a refused or absent reading, a constraint the flow
  # cannot produce, or a valid envelope that is not ready. Nothing draws an edge here from the
  # explore node and nothing needs to: a Hard blocker is routed to the graph's wait node by the
  # fabric itself, exactly as an UNDETERMINED the pack labelled no edge for is.
  - id: blocked
    kind: wait
    parameters:
      blocker: hard-blocker

edges:
  - { from: analyze, to: read-contract }
  - { from: read-contract, to: judge }
  # The constraint passed: the goal rule decides whether the Campaign is done, which is the
  # chooser's decision and not the edge's.
  - { from: judge, to: decide, outcome: PASS }
  # The constraint failed: a negative reading is a refusal, not a next experiment.
  - { from: judge, to: blocked, outcome: FAIL }
  # UNDETERMINED is left unlabelled on purpose: no reading exists, so no rule may pass.
saw.compiledRules:
# The constraint rule of this pack: a library contract reading may not be negative.
#
# It is deliberately a presence and non-negativity gate. The Golden Flow's own reader writes 1 or
# writes nothing, so from this flow the rule can PASS or be UNDETERMINED and its FAIL is
# unreachable; a negative count could only come from a reader other than the flow's. A PASS here
# says nothing about Library quality, PVT, revision or design impact — only that a bounded local
# authoring-qualification reading was present and was not below zero.
id: library-contract-nonnegative
version: '1'
title: The library contract reading is not negative

# What must have been observed for this rule to have an opinion at all. With no reading — the flow
# refused the input, or the envelope did not validate — this rule is UNDETERMINED, not PASS.
requires:
  - type: library_contract_ready

subject:
  type: library_contract_ready
predicate:
  op: gte
  threshold: 0
  unit: count
# The goal rule of this pack: the same reading must reach the bound goal of one count.
#
# `parameter` declares the one value a Campaign binds at judge time. The bound goal is one count in
# every Campaign of this pack — the contract's own bounds say so — because this Pack answers exactly
# one question: was the bounded authoring-qualification contract present and valid. A reading of 0
# fails this rule while passing the constraint, which is the valid-but-not-ready ending; a reading
# that does not exist is UNDETERMINED and never a substituted zero.
id: library-contract-goal
version: '1'
title: The library contract reading reaches the bound goal

parameter:
  name: library_contract_goal
  unit: count

requires:
  - type: library_contract_ready

subject:
  type: library_contract_ready
predicate:
  op: gte
  threshold:
    parameter: library_contract_goal
  unit: count
